name: Create identity token
description: Save an audience-bound bearer for the caller's exact identity in its secret store. Supports identities beneath this venue's signing key DID, including agents. Grants no permissions; requires secret/write on s/<name>. Generic invocation also requires invoke on the operation reference; a bound identity tool does not. Agents use their owner's secret store. No private key or bearer is returned.

aud.description: Target venue DID; required, without path, query or fragment.

name.description: Secret name for the generated bearer.

lifetime.description: Validity in seconds, as long as the caller chooses; the target venue may refuse a token that lasts longer than it allows. Refresh explicitly before expiry.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing secret when refreshing.

secret.description: Secret reference, s/<name>. Use with secret/use authority.
